alignments.note: Adverbial accusative taking the supplied *In* its case-function licenses (rule 33), a supplied *the* (rule 15) and the generic *season* (rule 31); head on the lexeme word *night*.
Verb with its auxiliary; head on the lexical verb (rule 24).
The compound preposition מֵעַל is rendered by the single word *in*; no morpheme owns a part of it, so the two share a unit headed on the governing morpheme (rules 23 and 30).

Anarthrous participle recast as *the pains that gnaw*; the supplied noun phrase joins its unit and the head falls on the word carrying the lexeme (rule 46). The italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
Suffix realized by the object pronoun *me* of the recast clause (rule 18).
Verb rendered by the light verb *take ... rest*; head on the complement (rule 44), discontinuous around the negative (rule 25).
Negative לֹא rendered by the determiner *no* standing on the complement (rule 15).
Paragogic nun has no English realization (rule 32).

review_notes: The marginal alternatives and the literal gloss *Hebrew from off* were read and set aside; מֵעַל is aligned to the printed *in* (rule 38).
*take no rest* is divided between the verb's light-verb rendering and the negative rather than fused, since the ASV writes a word for each morpheme (rule 35's closing limit).
